scenario: [LNUL.4.4] — `s.state is null` is a total null-test and FIRES when the reading is null (the only way to act on absence). fact_count 2.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float? mutable

schema Marker scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.state is null
->
    emit Marker logical entity_id: s.entity_id
